name: Phase 3 SLM Promotion Gate Static Gate
scope: Reusable validator for deciding whether an SLM benchmark report is promotable to runtime
promotion_requirements: sanitized model manifest is present, local_only, redistributable, and has a positive parameter_count
candidate validation is exercised with zero non-candidate violations
fallbacks are at or below the configured threshold
SLM p95 latency is at or below the configured target
SLM has fewer aggregate errors than deterministic
SLM relative error reduction versus deterministic is above the configured minimum
required promotion fixtures such as heldout_generalization_clean are present when requested
not_tested: a real SLM model passing the promotion gate
next_steps: Keep SLM Prototype unwired until a real model report passes this promotion gate.
Run future real-model reports through this validator with heldout_generalization_clean required.
Retain qwen2.5:0.5b as expected-fail evidence until a better local model exists.
